description: This file is a shell script used for testing various configurations and behaviors of git push.default settings, including setup of remotes, push success/failure tests, and different workflow scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks whether a specific commit has been successfully pushed by comparing local and remote logs.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a git push with specified push.default setting succeeds and verifies the push target.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a git push with specified push.default setting fails and that no remote changes occurred.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Runs a test scenario for push.default settings within different workflow contexts, like centralized or triangular.
